title: Reading a soil profile
summary: Distinguish modelled depth samples from measured stratigraphy.
body: A profile is read downward from the surface. Standard depth intervals are not cultural horizons. A missing value is not zero clay or zero carbon.
steps: Open a site's soil view and check its source and confidence label.
Compare the six depth intervals; distinguish missing properties from available model estimates.
Look for a supported bedrock or cultural-layer interval. If none is present, report depth as unknown.
Explain how a located, dated trench log would provide different evidence from a 250 m grid prediction.
